title: Activity Log — Extra Data
description: Schema for the tblActivityLog.logData JSON column. Contains context-specific metadata for the logged event.

page.description: Page or route that generated the activity

hourlyCount.description: Current hourly request count (rate limiting context)

dailyCount.description: Current daily request count (rate limiting context)

reason.description: Reason for the activity (e.g., validation failure message)

shortCode.description: Short code involved in the activity

orgHandle.description: Organisation handle involved in the activity

form.description: Which public form a 'rate_limited' event was refused on (#212)

hasSubject.description: Whether a contact_form submission included a subject line (#212; the subject text and the sender's email address are no longer stored here)
